_comment: SEEDED from the §4.9 literature table, every value traceable to a cited MAPE/PMAE figure. These are NOT measured. The 'How accurate is this?' page must show that distinction, because claiming a measured number we have not measured is the exact dishonesty this product exists to avoid. A golden-set run replaces these and flips provenance to 'measured'.

sources.B_packaged_labeled: Exact label arithmetic; 21 CFR 101.9(c) rounding only
sources.D_mixed_composite: Lo 2024: MAE 151.2+/-125.3 kcal mixed meal; Cinar 2026: up to 54% on complex plates
sources.E_hidden_fat: Oil absorption 10-28% by weight, invisible in a finished dish
sources.F_liquid_beverage: ABV spans 4.2-10% for a 12oz 'beer' — ~2.4x the alcohol
sources.external_reference: ACETADA (Purdue controlled-feeding RCT, weighed to 0.1g): GPT-4o 165.8 kcal MAE, Claude 3.7 Sonnet 181.7, Gemini 2.5 Pro 211.0. Fridolfsson 2025: GPT-4o 36.3% weight MAPE, Claude 3.5 Sonnet 37.3%.
